name: regulatory_report_submission
description: Orchestrator. End-to-end submission of a periodic prudential report to the Indonesian regulator. Validates the request, then runs the regulator edit-check suite and the prudential ratio calculation in parallel, combines both verdicts into one route (auto-submit / maker-checker review / breach remediation / return to preparer), pauses on a WAIT for the checker's sign-off where the route demands it, escalates a limit breach into the breach_remediation child, then has an LLM draft the transmittal memo, renders it to PDF, transmits to the reporting channel and records the receipt.

inputParameters.expression: (function(){var e=[];var req=function(v,n){if(v===null||v===undefined||String(v).length===0){e.push(n+' is required');}};req($.reportId,'reportId');req($.reportCode,'reportCode');req($.bankCode,'bankCode');var p=String($.period||'');if(!/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$/.test(p)){e.push('period must be YYYY-MM');}var dt=function(v,n){if(!/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/.test(String(v||''))){e.push(n+' must be YYYY-MM-DD');}};dt($.asOfDate,'asOfDate');dt($.submissionDeadline,'submissionDeadline');return {valid:e.length===0,errors:e};})();

(function(){var truthy=function(v){return v===true||String(v)==='true';};var valid=truthy($.valid);var canAuto=truthy($.canAutoSubmit);var late=truthy($.lateSubmission);var mandatory=truthy($.mandatoryNotification);var compliance=String($.complianceStatus||'');var errors=Number($.errorCount)||0;var warnings=Number($.warningCount)||0;var breaches=Number($.breachCount)||0;var reasons=[];var route;if(!valid){route='REJECTED';reasons.push('Laporan gagal '+errors+' edit-check yang bersifat blocking - dikembalikan kepada penyusun');}else if(mandatory||compliance==='BREACH_CRITICAL'||compliance==='BREACH'){route='BREACH';reasons.push('Terdapat '+breaches+' pelampauan rasio prudensial ('+compliance+') - wajib rencana tindak dan pelaporan ke otoritas');}else if(!canAuto||late||compliance==='NON_COMPLIANT_MINOR'||compliance==='WATCH'){route='REVIEW';if(warnings>0){reasons.push(warnings+' peringatan edit-check memerlukan penjelasan');}if(late){reasons.push('Penyampaian melewati batas waktu');}if(compliance==='NON_COMPLIANT_MINOR'){reasons.push('Rasio di luar ketentuan namun tidak wajib notifikasi segera');}if(compliance==='WATCH'){reasons.push('Terdapat rasio yang mendekati ambang batas');}}else{route='AUTO';reasons.push('Seluruh edit-check bersih dan seluruh rasio prudensial dalam ketentuan');}var requiresChecker=(route==='REVIEW'||route==='BREACH');return {route:route,requiresChecker:requiresChecker,routeReasons:reasons,routeReason:reasons.join('; '),errorCount:errors,warningCount:warnings,breachCount:breaches};})();

messages.message: You are a regulatory reporting officer (Satuan Kerja Kepatuhan) at an Indonesian commercial bank. Write a formal internal transmittal memo (nota dinas) in Indonesian, in Markdown, covering a periodic prudential report. Use ONLY the figures and findings supplied; never invent a ratio, an amount, a regulation, a finding or a date. State the reported prudential ratios against their regulatory limits, summarise the edit-check findings, and state the disposition. CRITICAL: never state or imply that the regulator has accepted, approved, received or validated the report - acceptance is the regulator's act, and the workflow has at most transmitted it. If the disposition is RETURNED_TO_PREPARER, make clear the report was NOT transmitted and list what must be corrected. If a limit was breached, state the breach plainly and note that a remediation action plan is required; do not minimise it. Be concise (under 380 words), factual and neutral. Begin directly with a heading and end with the signature block of the Satuan Kerja Kepatuhan. Do NOT include letterhead, postal addresses, a date line, or ANY bracketed placeholder such as [Tanggal] or [Nama]. Output raw Markdown only - no code fences, no commentary before or after.

inputParameters.expression: (function(){var status=String($.submissionStatus||'');var code=String($.reportCode||'').toUpperCase();var period=String($.period||'').replace('-','');var bank=String($.bankCode||'');var channelMap={LBU:'ANTASENA',LSMK:'ANTASENA',LBBU:'ANTASENA',LHBU:'ANTASENA',LCR:'APOLO',NSFR:'APOLO',KPMM:'APOLO',BMPK:'APOLO',RBB:'APOLO'};var channel=channelMap[code]||'APOLO';var transmitted=(status==='APPROVED_FOR_TRANSMISSION'||status==='APPROVED_WITH_EXPLANATION'||status==='APPROVED_WITH_BREACH_DISCLOSURE');if(!transmitted){return {transmitted:false,channel:channel,receiptNumber:null,transmissionStatus:'NOT_TRANSMITTED',reason:'Laporan tidak disetujui untuk disampaikan - status '+status,lateSubmission:false,sanctionRisk:false};}var seed=String($.reportId||'')+code+period;var h=0;for(var i=0;i<seed.length;i++){h=(h*31+seed.charCodeAt(i))%100000;}var seq=String(h);while(seq.length<5){seq='0'+seq;}var receipt=channel+'/'+bank+'/'+code+'/'+period+'/'+seq;var late=($.lateSubmission===true||String($.lateSubmission)==='true');return {transmitted:true,channel:channel,receiptNumber:receipt,transmissionStatus:'TRANSMITTED_AWAITING_REGULATOR_ACCEPTANCE',receivedAt:String($.asOfDate||''),reason:'Berkas diterima antrian '+channel+' - status penerimaan final menunggu konfirmasi otoritas',lateSubmission:late,sanctionRisk:late,daysToDeadline:$.daysToDeadline};})();

(function(){var status=String($.status||'');var name=String($.reportName||$.reportCode||'Laporan');var period=String($.period||'');var subject;var body;var recipients;if(status==='APPROVED_FOR_TRANSMISSION'||status==='APPROVED_WITH_EXPLANATION'){subject=name+' periode '+period+' telah disampaikan';body='Laporan '+name+' periode '+period+' telah dikirim melalui '+$.channel+' dengan nomor tanda terima '+$.receiptNumber+'. Status penerimaan final menunggu konfirmasi otoritas. Nota dinas terlampir.';recipients=['satuan-kerja-kepatuhan','pelaporan'];}else if(status==='APPROVED_WITH_BREACH_DISCLOSURE'){subject='PENTING - '+name+' periode '+period+' disampaikan dengan pengungkapan pelampauan';body='Laporan '+name+' periode '+period+' telah dikirim melalui '+$.channel+' (tanda terima '+$.receiptNumber+') disertai pengungkapan pelampauan rasio prudensial. Rencana tindak wajib dipantau sampai selesai.';recipients=['direktur-kepatuhan','satuan-kerja-kepatuhan','manajemen-risiko','komite-audit'];}else if(status==='RETURNED_TO_PREPARER'){subject='TINDAKAN DIPERLUKAN - '+name+' periode '+period+' dikembalikan';body='Laporan '+name+' periode '+period+' TIDAK disampaikan dan dikembalikan kepada '+String($.preparedBy||'penyusun')+' untuk perbaikan. Temuan: '+String($.errorsText||'-');recipients=['pelaporan',String($.preparedBy||'penyusun')];}else{subject=name+' periode '+period+' menunggu persetujuan';body='Laporan '+name+' periode '+period+' sedang menunggu persetujuan checker.';recipients=['satuan-kerja-kepatuhan'];}return {channel:'email',recipients:recipients,subject:subject,body:body,attachment:$.memoPdf,delivered:false};})();
